answer: Starve sybil farms by scoring voting weight from the diversity of inbound settlement, not from how many keys an operator can spin. Treat each distinct payer as a hard walnut: one funding source can nourish only a thin vine of influence, no matter how many child addresses it feeds. A cluster that shares a single root stays small. Weight accumulates only when payments arrive from disjoint neighborhoods, like streams meeting at a knoll from different valleys, and unused keys decay so fresh clones buy almost nothing.
